DEF-198.title: Whitespace-only Bid.adm passes the isStr() presence check and is never flagged as a blank creative
DEF-198.expected: Bid.adm is documented as carrying the actual ad markup for the impression; a string containing only whitespace carries none of it and should be distinguishable from a real creative.
DEF-198.actual: The exact reviewed deviations are pinned separately for each case and layer; successful or unrelated findings are not admitted as gaps.
notes: isStr(v) = typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0 (packages/core/helpers.js:9) treats any nonempty string, including one made only of spaces, as a present adm — response.bid.payload_missing (rules-response.js:140) therefore never fires for a blank creative, and no other rule reports it either.
Normative assertions were authored from the primary OpenRTB contract before execution. Known-gap signatures document the observed failure only; they are not an expected-output snapshot.

DEF-303.title: Oversized analyze body resets the connection instead of returning the documented 400 payload_too_large
DEF-303.source: docs/api-v1.md (POST /api/analyze errors: 400 payload_too_large when the body exceeds the 2 MiB parser limit)
DEF-303.expected: A body over the 2 MiB cap receives HTTP 400 with code payload_too_large in the documented error envelope.
DEF-303.actual: The server answers 100 Continue, then resets the socket while the body is still uploading; curl exits 56 and node/undici report ECONNRESET / fetch failed; no status or envelope is observable.
notes: Reproduced directly with curl --data-binary (3 MB) and node http.request against an isolated server; the documented status is never delivered.
Consolidated the independent encoding-limits observation formerly labeled DEF-199. The HTTP harness now records status 0 and the transport cause; this case uses the exact DEF-303 signatures.
